story.flightsuit.dbz_earth.welcome: Bulma (radio): "You made it! Come to Capsule Corp. Something with a strange power level is heading for Earth!"
tooltip.flightsuit.scouter: Hold in either hand and look at something within 64 blocks to read its power level
tooltip.flightsuit.senzu_bean: Eat it: full health, full hunger
dbz.flightsuit.bulma.welcome: Hi, %s! I'm Bulma. That suit is amazing... oh, take these - senzu beans. Goku's at Kame House. Something with a strange power level is heading his way!
dbz.flightsuit.bulma.met_bulma: Goku's at Kame House, out by the beach to the southwest!
dbz.flightsuit.bulma.met_goku: Something huge is reading near the crater! Be careful!
dbz.flightsuit.bulma.raditz_beaten: I looked at Raditz's scouter... two more Saiyans arrive tomorrow!
dbz.flightsuit.bulma.saiyans_beaten: You did it! Namek's next - I'm refitting the ship, give me a little while.
dbz.flightsuit.goku.raditz: Oh, %s! That armour looks strong! But... someone really strong just landed at the crater. Let's go together!
dbz.flightsuit.goku.arrived: Bulma was looking for you. Go see her at Capsule Corp first!
dbz.flightsuit.goku.met_goku: To the crater! I'll meet you there!
dbz.flightsuit.goku.raditz_beaten: More Saiyans coming? I can't wait! Let's train till they get here.
dbz.flightsuit.goku.saiyans_beaten: Vegeta was crazy strong! You're amazing. Let's go to Namek together!
dbz.flightsuit.goku.beaten: Ugh... let me catch my breath!
dbz.flightsuit.raditz.beaten: Ngh... Vegeta and Nappa will finish you...!
dbz.flightsuit.nappa.arrive: Hahaha! Saibamen - go play with them!
dbz.flightsuit.nappa.go: The Saibamen weren't enough? I'll do it myself!
dbz.flightsuit.vegeta.arrive: Hmph. The power levels on this planet are pathetic.
dbz.flightsuit.vegeta.go: Useless Nappa. The prince of all Saiyans will deal with you himself!
dbz.flightsuit.vegeta.beaten: Me... beaten...? Remember this. I'll be back!
story.flightsuit.none: No planet story yet. Fly to a planet from a launch pad.

thanos.flightsuit.ebony_maw.arrive: Rejoice. You stand before the children of Thanos.
thanos.flightsuit.ebony_maw.beaten: To lose the Space Stone... to you...

thanos.flightsuit.corvus_glaive.arrive: The Mind Stone is mine to guard.
thanos.flightsuit.thanos.arrive: Some things are inevitable. I am inevitable.

thanos.flightsuit.thanos.beaten: This time... you win. But I will return.

town.flightsuit.line.fort_farmer.0: The rains were kind this year - the wheat came up well.
town.flightsuit.line.fort_farmer.2: In the end it's us farmers who feed the soldiers.
town.flightsuit.line.fort_smith.0: A blade is born in the fire.
town.flightsuit.line.fort_smith.1: The general's spear keeps me busy.
town.flightsuit.line.fort_smith.2: Bring me good iron and I'll pay for it.
town.flightsuit.line.fort_cook.1: A full storehouse puts the mind at ease.
town.flightsuit.line.fort_cook.2: No one fights on an empty stomach.
town.flightsuit.line.fort_child.0: Have you seen the general's weapon? It's huge!
town.flightsuit.line.fort_child.1: I'll be a soldier when I grow up!

dbz.flightsuit.bulma.namek: %s, I found Namek's coordinates! They have dragon balls there too. Your launch pad can fly there now!
dbz.flightsuit.bulma.later: If you need anything, come by Capsule Corp anytime!

tip.flightsuit.suit.ryan_mk1:
Standard suit. Each part works on its own
Hold %9$s, empty hand: repulsor beam
%5$s micro missiles · %6$s unibeam
%4$s tap parry · hold energy shield
Full set: %7$s twice to fly, %8$s+forward fast
%1$s step out / call · %3$s suit wheel
tip.flightsuit.suit.ryan_mk2:
Stealth suit. Sneak in a full set to cloak
Hold %9$s, empty hand: cryo beam (keep it on to freeze)
%6$s cryo nova
Helmet scan 48 blocks
tip.flightsuit.suit.phantom_mk3:
Phantom suit. Can't fly
Hold %9$s, empty hand: card stream (cards home in)
%5$s Judgment Draw · %6$s card duel
%4$s tap: aim a shadow step (wheel = distance, click to go, 40 blocks)
%4$s hold: steal the skill the aimed foe just used
%12$s use the stolen skill · %11$s Tempest (a rain of cards)
tip.flightsuit.suit.hero_mk4:
Hero suit. Can't fly
Hold %9$s, empty hand: Master Sword (full health = beam)
%5$s spin attack · %6$s clawshot (%6$s again = let go)
The shield stops arrows from ahead
tip.flightsuit.suit.trunks_mk5:
Trunks, a flying swordsman
Hold %9$s, empty hand: three-step combo (across, down, thrust; all three stun)
%5$s Burning Attack · %6$s flash slash (a rush, untouchable)
%4$s tap: sword parry (the next cut lands twice as hard)
Cuts arrows and ki blasts coming at the front while slashing
%11$s Super Saiyan: everything 1.5x, the battery runs down fast
tip.flightsuit.suit.hulkbuster_mk44:
Hulkbuster. A full set makes you 1.5x big; fists, no repulsor
Hold %9$s, empty hand: punch flurry (extra damage when slammed into a wall)
%5$s piston punch: rush in, five blows, the last one stuns
%6$s ground slam: a 6-block shockwave (drops straight down if in the air)
Half damage from arrows · shoves small mobs aside · flies a little slower
tip.flightsuit.suit.nano_mk50:
Nanotech. The reward for beating Thanos
Repairs and charges itself every 2 seconds
%5$s missiles · %6$s unibeam (as Mark 1)
tip.flightsuit.arc_reactor:
The heart of a chestplate and a station
For the Mark 1 chestplate, suit station, launch pad
tip.flightsuit.energy_cell:
%9$s: charges the suit you're wearing
Also charges the hover car
tip.flightsuit.edith_glasses:
Glasses for your head: command HUD (time, position, suit charge)
%1$s: your main station's suit flies to you
%3$s: suit wheel (deploy, swap, remote pilot)
EDITH warns you of raids and alarms
tip.flightsuit.suit_station:
Unfolds into a 3x3, 4-high gantry
Stores, charges and repairs one suit
Empty %9$s: the arms suit you up / take it off
%10$s + %9$s: make it your main station
Needs power (solar, generator, battery within 8)
tip.flightsuit.solar_panel:
30 FE/t in daylight under open sky (30%% in rain)
Links to power blocks within 8, no cables
tip.flightsuit.generator:
Burns furnace fuel for 60 FE/t
